title: Routing policy lab: heatmap simulator for region-tier-fallback decisions
creator: Aisha Kramer
description: Build a 'Routing Policy Lab' feature inside Console that lets customers author region + tier + fallback model policies and preview their runtime behavior via an interactive heatmap simulator. The simulator should accept a policy, a synthetic traffic profile (latency, region mix, model availability), and render expected route selection, percent routed to each tier, and fallback events over time. Goal: reduce misconfigured routing and reduce Ops escalations for regional failover and model variant fallback scenarios. Deliverables: lab UX in Console, simulator engine (policy evaluator), policy validation rules, sample profiles and presets, documentation and guided walkthrough.
acceptance_criteria: Console has a new 'Routing Lab' tab under Policy Editor that can load an existing policy or start from templates
Simulator renders an interactive heatmap of requests-by-region vs time showing primary/tier/fallback chosen
Customers can inject synthetic failure scenarios (region outage, increased latency, capacity shortage) and see fallback model variant usage
Policy validator surfaces safety warnings (circular fallbacks, no fallback defined for <region>) with suggested fixes
Exportable report (CSV + screenshot) summarizing simulated routing percentages and time-to-fallback metrics
Tests: unit coverage for policy evaluation logic and e2e smoke tests for Console UI flow
design_notes: DES-1123 provided initial wireframes for heatmap color scale and timeline scrubber
Prefer compact colorblind-safe palette; include toggles for absolute counts vs percentages
Need contextual help tooltips explaining model-variant score vs latency tradeoff
engineering_notes: ENG-21458 to expose a policy-evaluation sandbox service in staging that accepts SNUBA-like traffic fixtures
Evaluation will reuse routing decision engine from runtime but run in a deterministic single-threaded mode for reproducibility
Performance: simulator must return a full trace for a 10k-req fixture within 2s in staging; optimize KV cache simulation to avoid O(N^2) behavior
Fallback semantics: evaluate in preference order (region -> tier -> model variant); include a configurable delay window to model transient latency spikes
milestones: M2: Policy evaluator service MVP + API (2026-03-22)
M4: Validation rules, docs, and rollout (2026-04-02)
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: simulator gives false confidence if synthetic profiles don't mirror production — Mitigation: include 'import recent traffic sample' option tied to anonymized telemetry
Risk: exposing internal routing semantics may confuse customers — Mitigation: show an 'explain' pane that maps policy clauses to human-readable decisions
Risk: heavy compute for large fixtures — Mitigation: add sampling and preset scenario sizes (small/medium/large)
